profile: release, thin LTO, one codegen unit
scope: Main integration compared with reviewed pre-merge feature build; not a comparison against bare upstream main or physical GPU.
move: 9 interleaved processes/build/target for shader mode, 3 for CPU mode; 9 warm frames/process, step 21; one component, Red+Blue, whole-layer control
transform: 3 interleaved processes/build for shader mode, 6 for CPU mode; 9 warm frames/target/geometry; composite, Red all visible, Red-only, Red+Blue all visible, Red+Blue-only; affine and 1x1 affine-patch Warp
confirmation_reason: Initial two-component shader Move and CPU Warp timings rose. All shader Move cases and all CPU transform cases, including whole-layer controls, were repeated; initial and confirmation samples are retained.
